Summary: ObsID builds JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that ship a local project indexer and surface token-level streaming completions. Primary ask: low-latency code completions (50-150ms median) for 80-120 heavy users, deterministic completions across teams (model/version pinning), and a hybrid architecture where local index lives on dev machines but inference runs on customer-dedicated/private Redwood runtime.
Key quotes: 'We cannot send raw source outside our VPC for IP reasons' — CTO Andrei. 
Technical requirements: streaming/partial-token responses, support for custom kernel selection to optimize StarCoder/Code LLMs, KV/prefix caching hooks for local index, model pinning & rollout control so we can A/B between quantized versions without breaking IDE behavior. 
Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS-backed key management, audit logs for developer queries, data residency in NA and EU for certain customers. 
POC scope: 2-week evaluation - install plugin beta on 15 dev machines, connect to Redwood dedicated POC cluster in their AWS account (VPC peering), run perf suite, collect token latency histogram, run QoE checks on completion correctness. 
Open items: legal needs model redistribution terms; engineering wants a small agent/runtime to run locally that can prefetch embeddings but not send plain code; finance needs committed monthly spend vs pay-as-you-go. 
Next meeting: integration workshop scheduled 2026-03-18 (AE + SE + infra + security).
